title: You Swapped Places with a Billionaire, Part 5

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your new face opens his phone.

lines.speaker: viewer
lines.text: What was your first pet called?

lines.speaker: young
lines.text: Ask my assistant. She remembers everything.

lines.speaker: viewer
lines.text: She wasn't there when you were six.

lines.speaker: viewer
lines.text: You named that tiny hamster Titan?

lines.speaker: young
lines.text: A shoebox. A wheel. More exercise than my board.

lines.speaker: viewer
lines.text: My bank account is being held hostage by a dead hamster.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Eight billion pounds. Protected by Mister Nibbles.

shots.anchor: Your new face opens his phone.
shots.description: The phone is already moving into view; its face lock resolves once.

shots.anchor: Your new face opens his phone.
shots.description: Cut to the adult caller after the short face-unlock insert; no held balance screen.

shots.anchor: What was your first pet called?
shots.description: The same phone asks for the first pet’s name; the financial obstacle is explicit.

shots.anchor: What was your first pet called?
shots.description: Adult viewer calls the former billionaire for the answer.

shots.anchor: Ask my assistant. She remembers everything.
shots.description: Young body tries to delegate a childhood memory to his assistant.

shots.anchor: She wasn't there when you were six.
shots.description: Viewer points out that she was not there when he was six.
Viewer makes one finite phone-tapping gesture while trying Titan.
The phone rejects the first answer on the spoken Wrong.
An uppercase retry changes the letters, then fails again.

shots.anchor: You named that tiny hamster Titan?
shots.description: Viewer reacts to the huge name given to the tiny animal.
Young body proudly remembers his pet’s office.
The cardboard lid starts opening on the cage question.

shots.anchor: A shoebox. A wheel. More exercise than my board.
shots.description: A close view reveals the shoebox, tiny hamster and wheel.

shots.anchor: A shoebox. A wheel. More exercise than my board.
shots.description: The hamster runs briefly inside the physical wheel and settles.

shots.anchor: My bank account is being held hostage by a dead hamster.
shots.description: Viewer reacts to the small, personal memory blocking access.
The young body remembers Mister Nibbles; the answer stays hidden until it is spoken.
The metaphor becomes a physical vault with a tiny hamster guard.

shots.anchor: Eight billion pounds. Protected by Mister Nibbles.
shots.description: The open vault reveals the account balance.

shots.anchor: Eight billion pounds. Protected by Mister Nibbles.
shots.description: Mister Nibbles gives one finite salute, recovers and holds through the ending.
